isolation.mode: read-only validation against the current working tree

assertionResults.reason: The analytics screen implements a horizontal row of pill-shaped time filters with a primary active state, white active text, and a bordered warm-card inactive state.

references.details: The time-range selector is horizontal and each pill uses borderRadius 999, primary active fill, white active text, and bordered inactive styling.
surface[100] and surface[300] resolve to the warm card (#F7F3ED) and border (#D9D0C4) tokens used by inactive pills.
The M3 primary role used by active pills resolves to the Cellar Ledger primary token #355847.

assertionResults.reason: The horizontal summary stat cards have the required warm card styling and 22px/700 values, but they do not render the required per-card trend arrows; trend icons appear only later in the separate Performance Score section.

references.details: The summary stat-card row is horizontal and uses colors.surface[100], a 1px border, 12px radius, 12px labels, and 22px/700 values.
The card row is using the required warm card and border tokens.
Trend icons are rendered only in the later Performance Score block, confirming the summary stat cards themselves omit the required trend arrows.

assertionResults.reason: The category breakdown renders row markers, names, counts, and progress bars with the required warm track color and category-color fills.

references.details: CATEGORY_COLORS defines the Cellar Ledger palette used by the breakdown rows.
The category breakdown card renders the required per-row marker, label, count, and progress bar structure.
The marker and fill use cat.color while the progress track uses colors.surface[200].
surface[200] resolves to #EEE7DD, matching the required progress-track color.

summary: Reviewed 3 assigned analytics assertions by read-only code review: 2 passed (VAL-ANALYTICS-001, VAL-ANALYTICS-003) and 1 failed (VAL-ANALYTICS-002, because the horizontal summary stat cards omit the required trend arrows).
